summary.text: Terry Austin is a Republican member of the Virginia House of Delegates, representing the 37th District since 2014.
The district covers Alleghany County, Botetourt County, Buena Vista, Covington, Craig County, Lexington and Rockbridge County.
The House profile lists Terry Austin's occupation as president/CEO of Austin Electrical Construction.

paragraphs.text: Terry Austin was born in Roanoke, VA.
The profile lists Virginia Western Community College under education.
The profile lists the Buchanan Rotary and the Botetourt Republican Committee.
Terry Austin serves on the Rules, Appropriations, Transportation, and General Laws committees.
